opening.flexibility_note: This is a strategic template, not a fixed build order. Adjust based on live scouting and enemy intelligence.
opening.opening_summary: A Zerg opening focused on heavy economy and expansion while maintaining a ground-oriented army. Early game emphasizes Zerglings and Queens, with moderate production and light technology investment. The strategy aims to outgrow the Terran opponent through superior economy and map presence, while staying flexible to adapt to observed Terran tech choices.
opening.strategic_goal: Develop a strong economy and expansion lead while building a ground-based army core. Maintain map presence and scouting to detect Terran tech transitions, and adapt your composition accordingly. Avoid overcommitting to a single tech path early, keeping options open for either ground or air responses.
